scope: Hermes-native Signal cutover parity for the Sable behaviors Arya still cares about.

checks.description: Hermes receives a direct Signal text message from Arya and sends a coherent reply.
checks.evidence: A live Signal DM reply produced by the Hermes gateway after the Sable bridge is stopped.

checks.description: Hermes preserves enough session/turn context for a follow-up Signal message.
checks.evidence: A second DM can refer to the previous turn without restating context.

checks.description: Hermes receives an image attachment over Signal and can describe or reason over it.
checks.evidence: A Signal image canary produces an answer grounded in the image content.

checks.description: Hermes receives a PDF/document attachment over Signal and extracts useful text.
checks.evidence: A Signal PDF canary produces an answer grounded in text from the PDF.

checks.description: Hermes handles an unsupported binary attachment without crashing or hallucinating file contents.
checks.evidence: A binary canary returns a clear unsupported/limited-processing response.

checks.description: Hermes transcribes an incoming Signal voice note through local STT and answers the spoken request.
checks.evidence: A voice-note canary returns an answer matching the spoken content.

checks.description: Hermes-native connector auth can read Gmail through its configured MCP/tooling path.
checks.evidence: A Hermes turn can retrieve or summarize a known harmless Gmail search result.

checks.description: Hermes-native connector auth can read Calendar and create/delete a throwaway event.
checks.evidence: A Hermes turn creates and deletes a test event without using Sable connector-card auth.

checks.description: A Hermes-native scheduled/cron workflow can send a canary message to the configured home channel.
checks.evidence: A short-lived Hermes cron canary fires once and is then removed.

checks.description: The first ported local integration lets Hermes perform a read-only Home Assistant status query.
checks.evidence: A Hermes turn reports a real Home Assistant state via a Sable-local tool/skill wrapper.

checks.description: The operator can stop Hermes Signal ownership and restart the old Sable bridge if live cutover fails.
checks.evidence: Documented rollback command path is checked before live cutover.
